current.text: Kennard signed with Phoenix this offseason.
Phoenix has a crowded group of guards and wings. Booker, Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, Collin Gillespie and Miles Bridges will all want touches.
One expert thinks too many guards are ahead of him for him to make an impact.
Ben (Locked On Suns) expects him to come off the bench and take about eight threes a game, making about 40 to 41%. That is a lower percentage than before, on more volume.
Ben worries that the projected Phoenix starting lineup has no reliable three-point shooter. That could open a shooting role for a bench specialist.

durable.text: Kennard is a pure three-point shooter. He does not get to the rim and is not a mid-range shooter.
He has historically taken too few threes for a shooter of his quality.

tags.detail: Ranked outside the top 144 on both sites. Watch for about eight three-point attempts a game off the bench.

note: Kennard is not a draft target for us. Yahoo ranks him 259 and ESPN ranks him 220, both value him at 0 USD, and our league did not draft him last season. His last line was efficient: 53.3% FG on 5.7 attempts and only 0.8 turnovers a game. But he scored 8.4 points with 1.5 threes, so he only adds value if his three-point volume clearly rises. In the first weeks, check whether he really gets the eight or so three-point attempts off the bench that Ben projects. If he does, he becomes a streaming add for threes. Ignore Yahoo's 67.3% FT projection, because he shot 91.3% last season on very few attempts.
